title: Native relay keeps deferring deliveries to a deleted session (409 'session not found') at every boot boundary instead of retiring them
outcome: A native relay delivery whose recipient session has been deleted is settled terminally, with a recorded reason such as 'recipient deleted', and visible to the sender. It is not deferred again with a 409 at every relay boot boundary. Deliveries to live sessions are unaffected.
acceptance: Native relay keeps deferring deliveries to a deleted session (409 'session not found') at every boot boundary instead of retiring them is done
